skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of health management to analyze, evaluate, and propose solutions for practical situations in health management.
Apply knowledge of health management to analyze, evaluate, and propose solutions for health policy situations.
Analyze and evaluate the impact of socialization on health management and quality assurance.
Demonstrate effective communication and presentation skills.
Demonstrate effective negotiation, teamwork, and time management skills.
Use economic and social research methods to analyze health management issues and make decisions.
Identify and solve practical problems in health management independently.
Demonstrate a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Develop the ability to learn independently and adapt to changes.
